problem: The shape requires every ship, including ships with nltl:shipIceStrengthened = false, to have exactly one construction date. The requirement only imposes the construction-date threshold as part of the applicability condition for ice-strengthened ships, so this adds an unsupported mandatory condition to non-ice-strengthened ships.
required_change: Remove the global sh:minCount 1 requirement for nltl:constructionDate and require one xsd:date construction date only in the nltl:shipIceStrengthened = true applicability branches before applying the date threshold.
regression_guard: Preserve the true-status date split: dates before 2026-01-01 follow the no-equipment branch, while dates on or after 2026-01-01 require one of the three equipment alternatives.
